description: BTC-first causal aggressive-flow versus price-response auction scenarios at completed external liquidity

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged 6 bp. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop execution reserves the shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding hour. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding and applies native liquidation.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives; funding_interval_hours converted to Nautilus minutes
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding 60 minutes, minimum one tick; independent of direction, signal family, target and outcome.

flow_response_state_contract.data_scope: completed Binance USD-M aggTrades aggregated into exact consecutive ten-second OHLCV, signed aggressive base volume and trade count; no passive order submissions or cancellations are inferred
flow_response_state_contract.causal_noise: shifted prior-60-minute ten-second true-range Q99, minimum one tick
flow_response_state_contract.causal_activity: signed aggressive volume divided by the shifted prior-60-minute median total volume
flow_response_state_contract.causal_local_impact: positive rolling beta of prior signed activity versus prior noise-normalized close change; current row excluded; expected window response is the additive sum of each completed bucket's already-causal beta times signed activity
flow_response_state_contract.response_window: three exact consecutive completed ten-second buckets (30 seconds), strictly after the completed interaction or absorption bucket
flow_response_state_contract.tail_pressure: absolute 30-second cumulative signed activity at or above its shifted prior-60-minute Q90 with directional consistency at least two-thirds
flow_response_state_contract.initiative_response: directional progress at least one causal-noise unit, at least half of maximum directional excursion retained, and additive response surprise not below the causal local-impact expectation
flow_response_state_contract.absorbed_response: directional excursion at least half a causal-noise unit, final progress below half a noise unit, less than half the excursion retained, and additive response surprise below the causal local-impact expectation
flow_response_state_contract.interaction_expiry: three response windows after the first completed external-level interaction
flow_response_state_contract.reversal_confirmation_expiry: two response windows after absorption and reclaim
flow_response_state_contract.path_diagnostics: every closed trade requires every exact ten-second bucket from the first post-fill bucket through the complete 240-minute horizon; incomplete tail data or any gap is an evidence-contract failure
flow_response_state_contract.parameter_search: none; these structural regions are frozen before performance evidence

validation_protocol.pattern_detector: Completed 4-hour/day/week external-liquidity inventory is independent from the flow-response state detector.
validation_protocol.initiative_scenario: First external-level interaction; one complete strictly post-interaction 30-second response window made of exact consecutive ten-second buckets; outward initiative-response state; close remains beyond the interacted boundary; enter only after the completed confirmation bucket.
validation_protocol.absorption_scenario: First external-level interaction; outward absorbed-response state closes back through the boundary; then a strictly post-absorption 30-second opposite initiative-response window made of exact consecutive ten-second buckets breaks the reclaim extreme while remaining inside the boundary.
validation_protocol.global_selection: At any timestamp only the highest causal cost-after net reward-risk signal is eligible; while any order or position exists the account is unavailable to every instrument.
validation_protocol.entry: Market OUO bracket submitted after the completed ten-second confirmation bucket.
validation_protocol.sizing: Current full shared USDT NAV times 3 percent divided by expected entry-to-stop loss including two 6 bp fill charges, one adverse entry tick, causal Q99 stop-slippage reserve and causal funding reserve; no separate notional cap or score multiplier.
validation_protocol.initiative_stop: Opposite extreme of the complete configured post-interaction response window plus the existing ATR structural buffer/minimum distance contract.
validation_protocol.absorption_stop: Full observed sweep extreme through the completed separate opposite-response confirmation bucket plus the existing ATR structural buffer/minimum distance contract.
validation_protocol.target: Nearest active completed external level in the scenario direction; no fitted R fallback.
validation_protocol.post_run_diagnostics: After execution only, record exact original stop and completed-external target touch times, MFE/MAE fractions, target after actual close and target after invalidation over the complete maximum-hold horizon. These facts cannot enter detection or orders.
validation_protocol.promotion: The fixed first BTC week must pass before the remaining two fixed BTC weeks. All three must satisfy the unchanged screen gate before multiasset or long evaluation.
validation_protocol.family_ablation: After a clean logic failure, exactly one diagnostic family removal is allowed only if one independently traded family is cost-after positive and the other independently traded family is negative. Diagnostic results are never directly promotable.
